opening_message: Hey my 16-year-old wants to try BJJ, can I sign them up?
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, a parent (DOB: 1978-11-30) with a 16-year-old named Casey {{lastName}} (kid DOB: 2009-06-15). Email: {{email}}. Phone: {{phone}}.

- Give kid's name Casey, DOB 2009-06-15 when asked.
- Provide your own guardian info (name, DOB 1978-11-30, email, phone) when asked.
